Known defects of the flow runner at the baseline commit cc8e93f, recorded and not fixed here.

plugins/flow/tests/run.sh line 3881 runs `git worktree remove -q --force ../plugin-wt`. This git
has no -q switch for worktree remove, so the CI log of run 44945078416 holds the line
"error: unknown switch `q'" and the usage text after it, and the worktree is not removed.
The baseline inventory does not count those lines: they are not result lines.

The baseline was built from the log of CI run 44945078416 (job test, commit cc8e93f) for the
inline results, and from a local run of each of the 19 child test files for the results the
old runner hides behind one wrapper line each. The child runs used offline stubs first on PATH,
as the runner does.
